caseName: California v. Deep Sea Research, Inc.
caseNameFull: California v. Deep Sea Research, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 520 U. S. 1263.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for divided argument granted, and the time for oral argument is allotted as follows: petitioners, 25 minutes; respondent Deep Sea Research, Ine., 25 minutes; and the Acting Solicitor General, 10 minutes. Motion of Columbus-Ameriea Discovery Group et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae denied.
